scite.title: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models

interpretation: SmoothQuant's ICML 2023 result concerns LLM W8A8. We independently adapt the algebra to SAM3 QKV; shift, clipped/geomean-normalized scales, FP32 norm folding, FP16 transformed weights, and optional weight mean-bias correction are separate experimental choices. No SAM3 or SM75 accuracy/speed transfer is assumed.
